summary_1line: Hanuman and the monkey search party, exhausted in the Vindhyas, discover and enter the mysterious Rikshabila cave, finding a hidden luminous world and an ascetic woman.

image_candidates.scene_text: The weary monkey warriors stand before the vine-covered mouth of the dark Rikshabila cave as swans and cranes emerge dripping with lotus pollen.
Inside the cavern, Hanuman and the monkeys gaze in amazement at golden trees, lotus lakes, and glittering palaces glowing like dawn in the underground world.
In the radiant subterranean chamber, the monkeys encounter a luminous ascetic woman clad in bark and black antelope skin standing calmly before them.
